payload.title: line base red: AGENTS.md drifts from cell(repo-preamble)
payload.body: The gate is red at line(suggestions-as-notes)'s base 25f9e3a1 alone: commit 25f9e3a1 (docs(agents): declare green-field register convention) added '- **Green-field register:** …' to AGENTS.md but not to its source cell(repo-preamble), so packages/canon test/hook-rule-boundary.test.ts fails 2 (byte-identical target; regenerateTargets --check drift [AGENTS.md]). Reproduced at 25f9e3a1 with no unit merged. Every unit's combination on this line goes red until the cell carries the line (or AGENTS.md drops it). Also met: the line worktree /home/lex/workspaces/cratylus.plan-suggestions-as-notes holds uncommitted source edits on resolved-notes' outputs, i.e. a unit being built in the line's worktree rather than its own off the line; the integrator left them untouched and gated in a clean detached worktree.
